rules.C0-C2_content: a content method (M2, M3, M4, M5 significant) verified the pair as C0, C1 or C2
rules.C3_named: content C3 (mixture component) and metadata naming the match: an M1 id / file-name / YouTube-window match on the pair, or a mixture recipe naming the matched source (DCASE2016 events)
rules.hub_lowcov: report only: the eval item is matched by more than hub.min_clips clips and the best match covers less than hub.min_cov_eval of it (short generic sounds)
rules.minds14_prompt: a clip matching more than minds14_prompt.min_items MInDS-14 items at C0-C2 (a shared phone prompt), also on low-coverage hub items
rules.nsynth_same_preset: an NSynth note of another velocity with the same preset and pitch as the eval note, at C0-C2
rules.nsynth_other_note: report only: an NSynth note of another preset or pitch
rules.libricount_source: a copy (C0-C2) of a LibriSpeech test-clean utterance that LibriCount mixtures are made of
rules.unscored_component: report only: other matches against unscored source recordings
rules.window_unmapped: report only: a match on a long eval recording that overlaps none of its scored windows
rules.C3_content: report only: content C3 without metadata
rules.M5_unidentifiable: report only: only an exhaustive-search match whose content cannot be identified at its length
rules.M1_only: report only: the eval item's own id without a content match
rules.M1_report: report only: other identifier matches without a content match

remove: in policy, and the exhaustive search found the pair significant, or did not measure it, or metadata names the match
